notes.title: Release notes for 0.227
notes.content:
[b][ GENERAL ][/b]

[list]
[*]Fully-functional dedicated servers for multiplayer matches.

[i]Developer comments: implemented use of dedicated servers for hosting matches instead of playing on one of the player's computer. This allows for more consistent in-game latency and avoids matches ending if host leaves.[/i]

[*]Updated skill points distribution interface.
[*]Added responsive Avatar attributes table.

[i]Developer comments: after received feedback, added Avatar attributes table that displays all stats of the player. Table also responds to skill point adjustments.[/i]

[*]Working inventory system.

[i]Developer comments: implemented working inventory system for items that is tied to user's Steam account. Items can be received after winning a match, and, in the future, will be offered to buy in a Shop , be crafted from other items or traded with other players. An overhauled Inventory screen with new features is currently in the works.[/i]
[/list]

[b][ GAMEPLAY ][/b]

[list]
[*]Players now receive rewards from the Treasure after the match.

[i]Developer comments: added rewards (in-game currency called Shards) that are given to players after the match ends. The members of winning team may also receive items that are added to their inventory and can be equipped.[/i]
[/list]

[b][ MISC ][/b]

[list]
[*]Various bug fixes.
[/list]

Working inventory system.
Players now receive rewards from the Treasure after the match.

notes.title: Project Apidom Demo and other important news!
notes.content:
Today we have exciting news to share with you!

[h2]Demo is Live[/h2]
We are pleased to announce that the Project Apidom Demo is live! You can download it from game's [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350700/Project_Apidom/]Store page[/url] now as part of the Steam Next Fest.

As this is our first public release, we are excited to share main features of the demo:
[list]
[*]Brute and Tech factions available;
[*]Minions and final boss Osir fully functional;
[*]Treasure capture (no items or resources);
[*]Selection of unlocked inventory items to try out;
[*]3 weapons available - Rare Bow, Epic Spartan Sword and Legendary Cyber Rune Axe;
[*]5 armor sets available - Common Aztec, Common Spartan, Rare Neko, Epic Samurai and Legendary Templar;
[*]Various abilities to use in matches - healing, fire strikes, etc.
[/list]

[h2]Check out our cinematic trailer[/h2]
[previewyoutube=IIcSUwhWVSM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About Project Apidom[/h2]
For everyone new here, let us tell you more about Project Apidom!

You play as Apidom - a robot that is a vessel for you consciousness, scavenging the surface of the planet called Pangea. Your main task is to find Treasures that consist of Shards and items such as weapons and armor pieces.

[h3]Main features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improving your Apidom with new items from captured Treasures;
[*]Using received skill points to change Apidom's stats according to your playstyle;
[*]Trading and crafting items with other players;
[*]Building your own Apidom suiting your playstyle and taking it into the battle.
[/list]
[h2]Play the Demo[/h2]
Let us know what you think about the game. Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/breachgg]Discord[/url], chat with devs and other players.

[h2]Join us on social media[/h2]
Discord - [url=https://discord.com/invite/breachgg]discord.com/invite/breachgg[/url]
Twitter - [url=https://twitter.com/ProjectApidom]@ProjectApidom[/url]
Website - [url=https://projectapidom.com/]projectapidom.com[/url]
